sections.heading: In depth
sections.body: Precipitation takes many forms — rain, snow, sleet, hail, drizzle — depending on temperature through the air column. Mountains wring moisture from air masses, creating wet windward slopes and dry rain shadows.

record_text:
Key points.
Precipitation. Rain, snow, sleet, and hail return water to the surface.

In depth.
Precipitation takes many forms — rain, snow, sleet, hail, drizzle — depending on temperature through the air column. Mountains wring moisture from air masses, creating wet windward slopes and dry rain shadows.
